title: 智平方郭彦东：堆再多GPU也不够，物理世界AGI怎么训
speaker: Guo Yendong

segments.en: Well, this is a really good question. I do simple maths.
segments.zh: 嗯，这是个很好的问题。我做个简单计算。

segments.en: I used to get my degree from Purdue University, I'm very proud of my university.
segments.zh: 我毕业于普渡大学，我为母校感到非常自豪。

segments.en: I do very simple maths. If we keep using the current structure of large foundation model, no matter how much electricity we have, no matter how many GPUs we have,
segments.zh: 我做个简单计算。如果继续沿用当前大模型的结构，无论我们有多少电力、多少GPU，

segments.en: that's not enough. So human beings just don't have enough GPU to train a fully completed NGI for physical world.
segments.zh: 那都不够。人类没有足够的GPU来为物理世界训练一个完全成熟的通用人工智能。

segments.en: So we need to find another way to solve this problem.
segments.zh: 所以我们需要另辟蹊径来解决这个问题。

segments.en: We find a lot of inspirations from how people bring work.
segments.zh: 我们从人类工作方式中获得了很多灵感。
因为人类工作非常高效。

segments.en: We don't need that much electricity to train people how to think, how to act.
segments.zh: 训练人类如何思考、如何行动并不需要那么多电力。

segments.en: We try to look at how neurons work.
segments.zh: 我们尝试研究神经元是如何工作的。

segments.en: So that's the foundation model of the robot needs to be more efficient on the edge to lower the usage of the computing power.
segments.zh: 所以机器人的基础模型需要在边缘端更高效，以降低算力使用。

segments.en: Yeah, and reduce the taxing on the grid as well, if you're doing edge computing.
segments.zh: 是的，如果做边缘计算，也能减轻电网负担。

segments.en: But again, how are you right now directly impacted by lack of access to the most cutting-edge processors, GPUs?
segments.zh: 但话说回来，目前无法获得最先进处理器和GPU，这对你们有多大直接影响？
